propositions: An s3:// or s3+zip:// ticket remote without a git-remote-s3 helper (>=0.3.2) can silently produce multiple-bundle corruption during push; the system must detect this misconfiguration and fail closed rather than allow the corrupting push.

A new internal guard _require_s3_helper_if_s3_url() detects S3 mode by remote URL scheme and raises OptionalDependencyError (naming pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]' and >=0.3.2 minimum) unconditionally to override best-effort semantics and prevent the push.

The preflight guard must be called at three points: synchronous push path after URL resolution, async push arm before detaching the child process, and init/_mount_or_create_branch after remote name resolution — reusing existing git remote get-url calls without new resolution seams.

OptionalDependencyError from the S3 preflight must propagate through write_and_push (uncaught) and be re-raised in push_after_commit's exception handler so it aborts the corrupting push while leaving the local commit durable.

Non-S3 remotes (file://, GitHub-style) and unresolvable remotes keep existing best-effort behavior; the S3 preflight is a no-op for non-S3 schemes, and remote-not-found skips are not misread as S3 mode.
The guard is keyed solely to URL scheme and reuses the existing SyncConfig.remote field, introducing zero schema changes or new config keys.
